Alex K.: Quick sync — Snowflake + Databricks vector connector marketplace listing is aiming for next Tue. AuroraEdge (HW partner) still needs firmware sign-off and the connector sample manifest. Can ops/eng confirm readiness?
Mira S.: I can own the sign-off path. Need confirmation on two things: 1) sample manifest matches marketplace schema, 2) our Dedicated capacity reservation is set for the demo window.
Samir R.: On capacity — Dedicated reservations are queued but not committed. Who's the final approver for the commit?
Jess L.: Legal needs the final feature list for the listing page before EOD Fri. Also we need an archive of the binary checksum from AuroraEdge for distro.
Alex K.: Approver for capacity is @Mira S. (product) + @Samir R. (eng infra) — Mira can you greenlight commit if staging tests pass?
Mira S.: Yes, I'll greenlight once CI and perf pass. Samir, can you run the soak from the perf job and drop results here by tomorrow morning?
Samir R.: Will run the soak tonight. Quick note on perf: quantized 4-bit model path has a ~12% higher throughput vs fp16 for our vector-retrieval token shapes. That may change the sizing delta for the Dedicated pool — sharing numbers after soak.
Alex K.: Pasting the manifest snippet AuroraEdge sent — please validate against marketplace schema:
```json
{
  "connector_name": "aurora-edge-vector-adapter",
  "version": "0.9.3",
  "compatibility": ["snowflake-connector-v2", "databricks-sql-connector"],
  "hardware_requirements": {
    "gpu": "A100",
    "firmware_checksum": "sha256:REPLACEME"
  }
}
```
Mira S.: Looks mostly fine. Need to replace firmware_checksum with the real hash and add `supported_models` list. Also add `max_concurrency` hint so marketplace can show expected throughput.
Jess L.: I'll coordinate with legal to clear the public feature bullets. Also please attach the final manifest to the marketplace listing ticket (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INTG-4321).
Samir R.: Perf soak passed: 8h soak, 99.95% p99 within SLA on the quantized path. I'm attaching short numbers here: avg latency 42ms, p95 68ms, p99 210ms for 128-token queries.
Alex K.: Nice. @integrations-bot can you snapshot the deploy preview and post the link?
integrations-bot: Deploy preview created: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/aurora-edge-connector-0.9.3 (expires in 72h)
Mira S.: Thanks. Two operational items: (1) we need a rollback plan if AuroraEdge firmware causes regressions — propose automatic fallback to hosted model variant and queued retry; (2) add a support escalation contact from AuroraEdge in the listing metadata.
Jess L.: Confirmed — legal wants the escalation contact + SOC2 attestation in the listing metadata. I'll loop in partner success for the contact.
Alex K.: OK next: announcement timing. We want a limited marketplace listing + partner blog next Wed. That means final signoff Tue COB. Can everyone confirm availability for a quick 30m huddle tomorrow 10:30am PT to lock final items?
Samir R.: I'm free. Will bring soak logs and capacity delta numbers.
Mira S.: Free. Will bring capacity commit decision.
Jess L.: Free. I'll have the legal checklist ready.
Alex K.: Great. Action items recap: 1) AuroraEdge provide firmware checksum + escalation contact (owner: Alex) 2) Samir run soak and post perf numbers (owner: Samir) 3) Mira commit Dedicated reservation after perf pass (owner: Mira) 4) Jess finalize legal metadata + attach to INTG-4321 (owner: Jess) 5) integrations-bot create deploy preview (done). We'll meet tomorrow 10:30am PT. :thumbsup:
